techParks.name: International Tech Park Bangalore
techParks.developer: CapitaLand India Trust (formerly Ascendas; original 1994 JV of a Singapore consortium led by Ascendas, the Tata Group and KIADB)
techParks.description: Bengaluru's oldest tech park, begun in January 1994 as an India-Singapore joint venture (Singapore consortium led by Ascendas 47%, Tata Group 47%, KIADB 6%) and now owned and managed by CapitaLand India Trust, for which it is the largest asset at 6.1 million sq ft of floor area (30 June 2026) on a 69-acre integrated site about 18 km east of the centre, with 92% committed occupancy including the newly completed MTB 6. Blocks: Discoverer, Innovator, Creator (2000), Explorer, Inventor, Navigator (1998), Pioneer (TCS's own), Voyager (Jun 2011, 0.5 msf), Aviator (Jan 2014, 0.6 msf), Victor (Jun 2016, 0.6 msf), Anchor (May 2019, 0.5 msf, SEZ), Anchor Annex (Nov 2020, 0.7 msf), Endeavour / MTB 6 (Jan 2025, 0.8 msf, fully leased to Applied Materials), a smaller MTB 4, and Tower 8 planned for late 2027; the park also holds the 450,000 sq ft Park Square mall (2010), a Vivanta by Taj hotel, a CapitaLand data centre and a Bridge+ flex-work centre. Part of the campus is a notified SEZ (the Aviator/Voyager/Victor/Anchor cluster). The OSM landuse polygon used for the bbox covers the core blocks and may not span the full 69 acres.

coverageNotes: Searches were cut short: the shared web-search budget ran out after ~24 queries, so the remaining verification was done with direct page fetches, the CapitaLand India Trust (CLINT) 1H2026 supplementary PDF, Wikipedia and OpenStreetMap. CONFIRMED in ITPB with company or press evidence: Mu Sigma (Aviator, own page), Societe Generale (Voyager and Victor, own pages), Applied Materials (Endeavour/MTB 6 lease 2025, press), ExxonMobil (Inventor lease 2026, press), TCS (Pioneer via Wikipedia + OSM, Anchor via a broker page); with listing/broker evidence only: HCLTech (Aviator), Conduent (Aviator, walk-in notices), GM Technical Centre (Creator, 2018 source), Technicolor (Navigator/Creator, closed Feb 2025), Light & Wonder, Endava/GalaxE, Amelia/IPsoft (all low). NOT SUBSTANTIATED inside ITPB and therefore LEFT OUT as park tenants, although the lens brief listed them: IBM (Wikipedia-mirror and broker mentions only; OSM places an IBM POI at First Technology Place across ITPL Main Road), Infosys (one unsourced broker blog), Mphasis, Dell, Tesco, Sapient, Mindtree/LTIMindtree, AOL/Yahoo, Airtel, Unisys (OSM shows it at SJR iPark and Residency Road), Delphi/Aptiv (OSM at Kalyani Platina and south Whitefield), NTT DATA/Perot (OSM at EPIP 2nd Road), Huawei (OSM at Kundalahalli), Xerox (covered via Conduent), SAP, Alstom and GE (the John F. Welch centre and Wipro GE are in EPIP/Kadugodi, outside the park). Wikipedia's tenant list also names AT&T, Soais, Sharp, Medtronic, Startek, GyanSys, Atos, Oracle, Unisys, First American and Airtel at ITPB; none could be tied to a block or a current page (GyanSys and First American contact pages were unreachable), so they are omitted. Broker tenant lists were used cautiously: loginrealty's block-by-block roster (e.g. Texas Instruments/Analog Devices in Innovator, Ericsson/Nokia in Explorer, CGI/Informatica in Victor, NXP in Voyager, Oracle/AT&T in Pioneer, Vodafone in Inventor, 'Pathfinder' and 'Discovery' blocks) contradicts better sources in several places and was not relied on without corroboration; cityinfoservices' block pages (Aviator, Voyager, Navigator, Creator, Anchor) were used for medium/low entries only. Small tenants named there (Nexgen Technology Services, Sycomp, Photon Infotech, CSS Corp/Movate, Slash Support, NTT Cloud Infrastructure, Sabre) are omitted for lack of a second source. CLINT's top-10 tenants (Amazon, Applied Materials, Bristol Myers Squibb, Capital One, Deloitte, Infosys, Societe Generale, Synechron, TCS, UnitedHealth Group as at 30 Jun 2026) are portfolio-wide across six Indian parks, so only those independently tied to ITPB are recorded. Coordinates: block footprints come from OSM (Discoverer, Innovator, Creator, Explorer, Pioneer, Voyager, Aviator, Victor, Anchor, Anchor Annex); Navigator, Inventor, Endeavour and Tower 8 have no OSM footprint and the geocoder returned garbage for them, so those offices use the park centroid or a same-company OSM POI and are capped at medium. The ITPB bbox is the OSM landuse polygon and may be smaller than the 69-acre site. GE HealthCare's branches page also lists an 'Inventor Building, 60 ITPL Main Rd, KIADB EPIP' service branch; the block name matches an ITPB building but the address is EPIP, and with no coordinate it was left out. Headcounts are null throughout because no source stated a Bengaluru-specific figure. Off-lens offices learned in passing (SocGen Pritech Park, Tata Elxsi, Alstom Bagmane, Capgemini EPIP, SAP Labs EPIP/ORR, Tesco EPIP, Wipro GE Kadugodi/Kalyani Platina, TCS GR Tech Park and EPIP buildings, Harman EOIZ/Manyata) are included for merging; the OSM-only ones are marked medium. Harman's EOIZ site is listed by BSI (SoA dated 27 May 2026) with related sites under 'Connected Services Corporation Wipro India Pvt Ltd', which suggests Harman's services unit has changed hands; this is flagged in aliases and not asserted.
